Quick technical readout and recommendation:

Summary recommendation:
- For initial onramp: Dedicated in eu‑west is viable as long as we: (1) pin routing to eu‑west hosts, (2) contractually commit to data residency and (3) exclude EU PHI from cross‑region backups. This meets their 90‑day request and has faster time to value than Private.
- Longer term (3–6 months): provision Private (VPC) for PHI flows if Acme wants an air‑gapped/managed VPC.

Latency/throughput expectations (eu‑west Dedicated, N1/Dedicated standard sku):
- p95 for 300 tokens: ~180–260ms (depends on batching; recommend minimal batching for UI flows)
- tokens/sec: 18–25 (per instance, model dependent)

Implementation notes for Private (if required):
- Prep time: 4–6 weeks to provision infra, network peering, and KMS/HSM integration (accelerated pathway available with customer network readiness)
- SOC2 evidence: security can provide a snapshot; operations will need a little time to produce audit log extracts for procurement.

I'll attach a short appendix with measured latencies from eu‑west staging runs. If Legal insists on Private for launch, we can parallelize workstreams but expect a ~4–6 week slip to the canary.

— Rishi
